profile.reading: Per a MARA (Marathon Digital Holdings) community engagement page, this Granbury, Texas facility traces to Compute North, which broke ground on a 300 megawatt data center in Hood County, Texas in April 2022; MARA acquired Compute North assets after its 2022 bankruptcy per general industry knowledge not independently confirmed this session. The page explicitly does not state whether 300 MW reflects MARAs current operating capacity at this facility today, so it is recorded here as an unconfirmed lead rather than adopted as critical_it_mw. No street address or square footage is published on this page.
